newsitem.title: USA: T. Rowe Price has higher third quarter.
newsitem.headline: T. Rowe Price has higher third quarter.

text.p: T. Rowe Price Associates Inc., the investment and mutual fund company, Friday reported higher third quarter earnings.
Baltimore-based T. Rowe Price had earnings for the third quarter of $25.9 million, or 42 cents a share. A year earlier it earned $20 million, or 33 cents per share.

"Appreciation on stock assets under management as well as strong net cash inflows to the equity mutual funds were the driving forces behind the significant growth in investment advisory fees and record levels of total (assets under management)," said Chief Executive Officer George Collins.
The company said total assets under management at Sept. 30 rose to $92.9 billion, from $72.5 billion a year earlier.
